items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The entry into force date of 10 November 2026 has passed, moving the act to stage 3 (In force).

items.text: New status text: “In force. Entered into force on 10 November 2026. The revised ESRS apply from financial year 2027, while the voluntary reporting standard has been in force since 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Update status text now that the 10 November 2026 entry into force date has passed.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims commission confirms decision to scrap proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed plans to scrap/withdraw the Green Claims Directive proposal.

items.text: New status text: “Withdrawn. The European Commission confirmed in November 2026 that it is scrapping the proposal following the cancellation of trilogue negotiations in 2025.”
items.reason: Update status to reflect the Commission's decision to withdraw the proposal.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached to increase free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries”
items.reason: The Council and European Parliament reached a provisional deal on 12 November 2026 regarding additional free carbon allowances under the EU ETS.
